title: Moscow cries fraud abroad while fixing the vote at home
text: EUvsDisinfo – analiza: Moscow cries fraud abroad while fixing the vote at home. Moscow routinely portrays elections in democratic countries as fraudulent and controlled from abroad. Yet Russia’s own parliamentary election offers no genuine political choice: the Kremlin controls the field and has eliminated even the possibility of voting against the war in Ukraine. As the war’s effects reach deeper into everyday life, growing public dissatisfaction is being kept out of the ballot box. When post-Soviet states turn away from Russia, as Armenia or Moldova have done, Kremlin officials and aligned outlets usually blame Western interference . Yet Moscow has itself tries to influence elections through foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI), often alongside financial support for pro-Russian groups. Moldovan authorities say Russian agents spent about €200 million – nearly 1% of Moldova’s GDP – on vote-buying and disinformation during the country’s 2024 presidential election and EU referendum. Investigators later found that the sanctioned Russian organisation Evrazia had used similar tactics ahead of Armenia’s 2026 election. Moscow nevertheless portrayed EU assistance intended to counter such threats as election interference . The Kremlin also regularly portrays established Western democracies as vulnerable to election manipulation. Posters currently displayed in the Moscow metro claim that journalists are barred from polling stations in Austria and Canada and that 42 of the 50 US states have no election monitoring. These claims are misleading: restrictions on journalists do not exclude authorised observers or party representatives, while almost every US state permits some form of public or partisan observation. The aim is to suggest that fair elections do not exist, so that any evidence of fraud in Russia could be dismissed as normal practice elsewhere. Unfair elections? Look no further than Russia Independent analysts agree that in Russia, election results have long been predetermined : the Kremlin controls every step, from candidate selection to ballot stuffing and vote counting. International observers, domestic monitoring groups and researchers have documented extensive manipulation in every State Duma election since 2011. The Center for Data and Research on Russia (CEDAR), an independent think tank, found evidence of widespread ballot manipulation across 12 federal elections held between 2000 and 2024.
